newsitem.title: FRANCE: SOCCER-THREE GOALS IN SIX MINUTES FOR BAKAYOKO.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-THREE GOALS IN SIX MINUTES FOR BAKAYOKO.

text.p: Ivory Coast striker Ibrahim Bakayoko scored three goals in six minutes as Montpellier beat Lille 4-0 away in the French first division on Tuesday.
The defeat pushed Lille nearer relegation while Nantes hung on to third place with a 0-0 draw at fourth-placed Bordeaux that extended their unbeaten run to 24 league games.
Leaders Monaco are away to bottom club Nice and second-placed Paris St Germain visit defending champions Auxerre on Wednesday.

Montpellier, unbeaten in 10 league matches and 3-0 winners at Lille three weeks ago in the French Cup, dominated but did not manage to translate their control into goals until the 68th minute when Bakayoko scored his first.
The Ivorian struck again two minutes later and completed a hat-trick in the 74th, while former France international Franck Sauzee added a fourth goal eight minutes from time.
Bordeaux are at home to Montpellier in the quarter-finals of the French Cup this weekend in a repeat of their League Cup semifinal which Bordeaux won on penalties.
